description: Published list prices side by side, cheapest first, with the assumptions stated. Without unit: model token prices per million (input, output, a blended figure at 3 input tokens to 1 output, context window). With unit (1k-requests, 1k-pages, audio-minute and so on; the result lists them): what each tool charges per that unit, with the vendor's note on what the price covers. Prices are only compared within one unit; a free row is a free tier with its limits in the note. Use it when a user asks what something costs or which is cheapest.

limit.description: How many rows to return, cheapest first (default 40); the result says how many there are

maxBlended.description: Models only: at most this many dollars blended per million tokens

unit.description: A unit such as 1k-requests or 1k-pages; empty for model tokens

name: get_prices
title: Compare prices
